The '''1931–32 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]] by five points over nearest rival [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Dundee United F.C.|Dundee United]] and [[Leith Athletic F.C.|Leith Athletic]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1932–33 Scottish Division Two]].
